rows.description: A toddler pokes at every new object, asks for the same story with tiny changes, and moves toward unfamiliar sounds and textures. The drive is pure interest; safety still has to come from the adults nearby.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: curiosity, interest, trust

rows.description: A child lines up shoes, remembers bedtime steps and gets upset when a game is left unfinished. Feels calmer when things have a place, and pride grows when tidy-up is noticed.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child forgets bottles, loses worksheets and works in bursts when interest strikes. Feels bad about reminders and is not lazy; simple routines and visual checklists help more than scolding.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A wise teenager keeps a plan but builds slack into it, treating a missed day as information rather than failure. Consistency counts more than perfection, and sleep is part of the plan.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtype: Living with a very careful partner or roommate [Receiver]
rows.description: A person living with a highly orderly housemate feels safe about bills and chores, and also watched and corrected. Says plainly what is a preference and what is a real need to avoid quiet resentment.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A team notices the person who always delivers on time, remembers details and quietly fixes gaps. They are trusted, but may be over-relied on and unthanked until they burn out.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A toddler waves at strangers, seeks people to play beside and gets loud with excitement. Energy rises around others and dips when alone; adults still teach gentle limits.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child says exactly what they think, argues for fairness and does not easily give way. Low agreeableness at this age often means honesty and determination, and needs guiding toward kindness in tone.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 1–3, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A child gets stomach aches before tests and replays small embarrassments for days. Feels emotions strongly and slowly recovers, and benefits from naming feelings and practising small steps.

rows.description: A classmate sees a friend who overthinks messages and cancels plans at the last moment. It is not drama; being patient, steady and consistent makes the friend feel less alone.
